hospitals.title: Hospitals
hospitals.intro: A hospital groups its boards (for example an R-BAY hospital's notices, form box and regulations). Projects, IRB pipelines, guides and forms are kept per hospital. Every user sees the hospital names; board documents stay members-only where they are.
hospitals.name: Name
hospitals.boardCount: {n, plural, =0 {no boards} one {# board} other {# boards}}
hospitals.moved: Board moved. Its documents moved with it; pipelines, guides and forms stay with each hospital.
hospitals.needForMembersOnly: Choose the hospital for a members-only source. Hospital names are visible to every user, so none is made from this source's name.
hospitals.automaticHint: Automatic: the hospital of another board on the same site (R-BAY hospital code, SNUH), else the hospital named like the board (R-BAY: the part before " : "), created if missing.

pipeline.title: IRB pipeline setup
pipeline.intro: The steps a study goes through at a hospital's IRB. Users get one pipeline per project and hospital, copied from the step order below when they create it; later changes here do not change existing pipelines. A step type's AI settings are read when a draft is made, so changes apply to the next draft. These settings are for the whole server.
pipeline.orderIntro: The global order is used for every hospital without its own order.
pipeline.usesGlobal: This hospital uses the global order. Saving makes it its own order.
pipeline.orderSaved: Step order saved. New pipelines use it; existing ones keep theirs.
pipeline.ownRemoved: This hospital uses the global order again.
pipeline.typesIntro: Each step type has its own AI settings: instructions added after the fixed safety rules, default guides and form, what the AI reads by default, and the documents the step needs. Users can change the guides, form and inputs per draft.
pipeline.instructionsHint: {used} / {n} characters. Added after the fixed safety rules, which always win.
pipeline.noGuides: No guides in the library yet.
pipeline.inputs: What the AI reads by default
pipeline.inputEarlier: Files of earlier steps in the same pipeline
pipeline.requiredDocsHint: One per line, e.g. protocol, consent form. The step page shows which are uploaded.
pipeline.requiredCount: {n, plural, one {# required document} other {# required documents}}
pipeline.statusesIntro: The first open status is the starting status of a new step. Closed statuses mark a finished step (no due-date reminder). At least one open and one closed status always stay.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Accounts are made here with a temporary password; give it to the user yourself (it is not sent by mail). Delete blocks the login and can be undone. Access to members-only sources is given on each source's page, not here.
users.passwordHint: At least {n} characters. Not stored here or shown again.
users.shortPassword: The password needs at least {n} characters.
users.created: {email} created in {org}. Give them the temporary password.
users.deletedDone: Deleted: the login is blocked. Restore any time.
users.restored: Restored: the user can sign in again.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.intro: An organization groups users and is the unit for statistics. It never gives access to anything: members-only sources are still opened to each user on the source page. Each user belongs to exactly one organization; new accounts join Default.
orgs.name: Name
orgs.deletedDone: Deleted. Its statistics are kept; restore it any time.
orgs.pickTarget: Choose the organization to move the user to.
orgs.moved: {email} moved to {name}. Their usage counts there from now on.
orgs.badMonth: Choose this month or an earlier one.
orgs.statsNote: Calendar month in Seoul time. Usage counts in the organization the user belonged to at the time. Members, new accounts and "signed in" use each user's organization now; "signed in" means the last sign-in falls in the month (only the last sign-in date is kept). Usage before 2026-11-11 counts as Default. Click an organization for its users.
orgs.noUsers: No users and no usage in this month.

templates.title: Form templates
templates.intro: A hospital's blank form as a Word .docx. The docs generator fills its blanks and the user downloads the form filled in, with its own layout. After uploading, check the fields the server found; the form is offered only after its fields are saved. Then make it global or choose its sites.
templates.namePlaceholder: For example: SNUH amendment request form
templates.markerHint: Only .docx (save HWP or .doc forms as .docx first). Type '{{'name'}}' where an answer must go for exact places; empty cells next to their labels, ☐ boxes, ____ lines and empty lines after a ':' are found by themselves.
templates.madeGlobal: The form is now offered for every site.
templates.madeSiteSpecific: The form is now offered only for its chosen sites.

reviews.title: Documents needing review
reviews.intro: Posts with a file problem: a file too big to download, unreadable, damaged or password-protected, or a broken zip. The post itself is stored. Mark it OK once checked: it stays quiet until the problem changes. A post that failed to load cannot be marked OK; it keeps its old state until the cause is fixed.
reviews.count: {n, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} (newest first, at most 500)
reviews.okHint: Stays quiet until this file problem changes.
reviews.failedPost: This post failed to load and keeps its old state; it cannot be marked OK here.

ai.title: AI instructions
ai.intro: Add instructions to each AI feature: tone, wording, terms, format. They are added after the fixed safety rules, which cannot be changed here (document text is never obeyed, no links or HTML, the chat cannot change anything). A saved change applies to the next AI answer, with no restart.

featureHint.agent: The chat every user can open from any page.
featureHint.docgen: Drafts of IRB submission and amendment forms. Hospital guides are added separately, per source.
featureHint.summary: Change summaries during scans and whole-document summaries; one text for all of them.

ai.label: Added instructions
ai.placeholder: For example: answer in polite Korean (존댓말); call the consent form '동의서'; keep answers under 5 bullets.

ai.saved: Saved. The next AI answer uses it.
ai.confirmReset: Remove the added instructions for this feature? The old text stays in the history.
ai.restored: Restored. The next AI answer uses it.
ai.testHint: Runs once with the text in the box (saved or not) and shows the answer. Nothing is saved. 30 test runs per admin per day.
ai.question: Question
ai.documentIdHint: The number in a document's address (…/documents/123). Sources with AI off may be used for tests.
